_note: Gold set for measuring extraction accuracy.
Synthetic summaries written to look like real Indian discharge summaries:
terse, abbreviation-heavy, inconsistent headings, and with the deficits
described in prose rather than as a checklist. That prose is the hard part
and the reason per-field accuracy is reported rather than one number.
`expected` holds ONLY fields a careful human would fill from that text. A
field absent here must come back BLANK - extracting it is a false positive
even if the value happens to be clinically plausible.
-- ON REVISING THIS FILE AFTER SEEING MODEL OUTPUT --
Adjusting a gold set to match what the model produced is how an evaluation
quietly becomes meaningless. It happened once here, legitimately, and the
rule that made it legitimate is recorded so it can be applied again:
A label may only be added if the SUMMARY TEXT supports it, and the
supporting sentence is written into `_justification` below. If the
justification cannot be written without appealing to what the model said,
the label does not go in.
The first run scored 61/61 correct with 6 'spurious' extractions. On
inspection all six were supported by sentences I had failed to label -
the evaluation found errors in the gold set, not in the model. Each is
justified below.

cases.text:
DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Ward 3B

74/F admitted with sudden onset right sided weakness. Symptoms began 08:00, reached casualty 14:30.
On arrival GCS 13, drowsy but rousable. BP 172/94 mmHg, PR 96 irregular.

O/E: Right upper limb power 3/5. Expressive dysphasia present. No facial asymmetry.
Visual fields could not be assessed due to drowsiness.

ECG: atrial fibrillation.
NCCT head done prior to treatment - established left MCA territory infarct.
Classified as PACS.

Discharged on T. Aspirin 150mg OD. Received prophylactic dose enoxaparin during stay.
Daughter is primary carer, contact 9876543210.

_justification.caregiver_contact: 'Daughter is primary carer, contact 9876543210.' - stated outright; my omission.

cases.text:
Discharge Summary

58 year old gentleman, known hypertensive, presented 3 hours after onset of left leg weakness noted on waking.
Fully conscious throughout, GCS 15. Admission BP 148/88.

Examination: isolated left lower limb weakness 4/5. Speech normal. No visual field defect. No neglect.
Cardiac: regular rhythm, sinus on ECG.

MRI brain: right lacunar infarct in corona radiata. Imaging done before starting treatment.
LACS.

Plan: aspirin 75mg daily on discharge. No heparin given.

_justification.deficit_arm: 'isolated left lower limb weakness 4/5' - 'isolated' excludes the other limbs. Reading the meaning of a word is comprehension, not inference from what is typical.

cases.text:
SUMMARY OF ADMISSION

67 year old female. Stroke.
BP on admission 160 systolic.
Right arm weak.
For physiotherapy follow up.

DISCHARGE NOTE

81 yr old lady. Brought in 2 hours after collapse witnessed at home.
GCS 7 on arrival, intubated. BP 195/105.

Dense left hemiplegia involving face, arm and leg. Gaze deviation to the right.
Fields and higher functions not testable given conscious level.

CT: large right MCA infarct with early swelling. Scan performed on arrival before any treatment.
TACS.

No antiplatelet started given infarct size. Prophylactic LMWH held.

_justification.deficit_other: 'Gaze deviation to the right.' - a focal deficit belonging to none of the named categories, which is exactly what deficit_other is for.
_justification.deficit_visuospatial: 'Fields and higher functions not testable given conscious level.' - visuospatial function is a higher function, and 'not testable' is cannot_assess rather than absent.

cases.text:
Discharge summary

70/M. Presented 5 hours from onset with slurred speech and unsteadiness.
Alert, GCS 15. BP 138/82.

Dysarthria present. Ataxia of the left limbs, diplopia on lateral gaze.
Power preserved in all four limbs. No facial weakness.

CT head normal at presentation. Done before treatment.
Rhythm: sinus.

Started on aspirin.

_justification.deficit_arm: 'Power preserved in all four limbs.' - explicit statement that the arms were examined and normal.
_justification.deficit_leg: 'Power preserved in all four limbs.' - same sentence covers the legs.
